thread:
Ben (AE): Claire from Meridian Clinics asked for a concise POC plan they can sign this week. Goal: validate 2 core workflows in a 30-day trial and confirm SLA/pricing. Can SEs propose prioritized journeys + concrete eval seeds + estimated infra needs?
Marisol (SE): propose MVP=2 workflows: 1) Patient intake + triage (chat) - endpoint: POST /v1/triage -> stateful, 3-turn avg, context up to 600 tokens. 2) Encounter summarization (structured note) - endpoint: POST /v1/summarize -> single-turn, output JSON fields (problem_list, assessment, plan). Leave batch coding to stretch.
Olivia (SE): acceptance metrics draft:
  - Triage: intent F1 >= 0.82 on 150 labeled conversations; critical-urgency recall >= 0.95.
  - Summaries: BERTScore >= 0.68 and clinical fact accuracy >= 0.90 on 250 notes (fact accuracy means no invented diagnoses/meds).
  - Ops: p95 latency (dedicated) <= 700ms for triage; p50 <= 150ms for summaries for <=128 tokens. Error rate <0.5%.
Ravi (PM): infra ask: for 30-day pilot recommend 1x dedicated small pool (4x A10G equiv) with autoscale off for predictable perf; estimated cost baseline ~ $11k for trial (list), offer pilot discount 40% on that if they commit to 3-month post-trial. Also flag: prefix KV caching for triage will lower token costs by ~20%.
Jamal (Security): quick security checklist: SOC2 present; we support customer-managed KMS, VPC peering, and optional on-prem image. For HIPAA use we require a signed BAA + DPA. Logs can be redacted; we can disable long-term retention. Claire, is BAA required for pilot?
Claire (Customer): BAA required. Also need data residency in us-east-1 and no PHI kept beyond 14 days during pilot. Can we provide synthetic labeled data first?
Marisol (SE): synthetic data OK for initial tuning. We'll need at least 100 labeled triage dialogues and 200 clinician notes for a reliable baseline. For summary outputs we will provide a JSON schema to validate model responses.
Olivia (SE): eval seed examples (will expand to 150/250):
```
# Triage seed
Patient: "I have high fever and shortness of breath for 2 days"
System instruction: "Classify urgency: routine / urgent / emergency. Provide one-line recommended next step."

# Summarization seed
Input: [CLINIC_NOTE]
System instruction: "Return JSON with keys: problem_list (array), assessment (1-2 sentences), plan (3 bullet points). Do not invent medications."
```
Ben (AE): commercial terms we should propose: 30-day Dedicated pilot with 40% pilot discount on list; option to convert to 3-month paid commit with 20% additional discount. Pilot SOW to include committed throughput toggles and SLOs. Claire, any constraints on billing?
Claire (Customer): approval process: legal + security signoff. Procurement needs a 1-page SOW and estimated costs. We can accept pilot discount but need final pricing for conversion in SOW.
Ravi (PM): timeline sketch: Day 0 SOW signed -> 48h env provision -> Week 1 prompts + synthetic tuning -> Week 2 eval runs -> Week 3 tuning & monitoring dashboards -> Week 4 acceptance run & handoff. Contingency: add 1 week if customer needs HSM/KMS onboarding.
Marisol (SE): ops runbook items I'll produce: endpoints, required input formats, test data upload flow (S3 + presigned URLs), monitoring dashboards (latency, token usage, model fallback), rollback plan (fallback model with lower perf).
Olivia (SE): ownerships:
  - Marisol: runbook + acceptance spreadsheet (due EOD tomorrow).
  - Olivia: build eval harness & seed prompt pack (start today, 5 business days).
  - Jamal: start BAA/DPA thread with Claire and security docs (today).
  - Ben: send draft SOW and pilot pricing; coordinate calendar.
Claire (Customer): we'll upload synthetic samples by EOD and target a 2-week delivery of labeled data. Legal will review SOW; ping procurement contact: veronica.proc@meridian.org.
Ben (AE): scheduling: propose kickoff Thursday 11am PT. everyone free?
Marisol (SE): I can.
Olivia (SE): yes.
Jamal (Security): ok.
Claire (Customer): Thursday works.
Ben (AE): great. I'll post the SOW snapshot and an owner list in the shared drive and send invite. Thanks all.
